sql-set.sql: SELECT CAST([Id] AS NVARCHAR(36)) AS [Id], [PolicyNumber], [PolicyName], [LineOfBusinessCode], [PolicyType], [StatusCode], [TransactionType], [QuoteId], [RenewalStatus], [InsuredId], [InsuredName], [InsuredAddress], [EffectiveDate], [ExpirationDate], [OriginalEffectiveDate], [AccountingDate], [CancellationDate], [CancelReasonDescription], [TotalPremium], [SumInsured], [Deductible], [Currency], [ProducerCode], [ProducerName], [UnderwriterId], [UnderwriterName], [AgentCode], [VesselName], [VesselType], [CargoType], [RouteFrom], [RouteTo], [AircraftRegistration], [FlightNumber], [RiskDescription], [SurveyorName], [Remarks], [CreatedBy], [CreatedDateTime], [UpdatedBy], [UpdatedDateTime], [CustomFields] AS [CustomFieldJson] FROM [McaPolicy] WHERE [Id] = @Id AND [IsDeleted] = 0;

SELECT CAST([Id] AS NVARCHAR(36)) AS [Id], [PolicyNumber], [PolicyName], [LineOfBusinessCode], [PolicyType], [StatusCode], [TransactionType], [QuoteId], [RenewalStatus], [InsuredId], [InsuredName], [InsuredAddress], [EffectiveDate], [ExpirationDate], [OriginalEffectiveDate], [AccountingDate], [CancellationDate], [CancelReasonDescription], [TotalPremium], [SumInsured], [Deductible], [Currency], [ProducerCode], [ProducerName], [UnderwriterId], [UnderwriterName], [AgentCode], [VesselName], [VesselType], [CargoType], [RouteFrom], [RouteTo], [AircraftRegistration], [FlightNumber], [RiskDescription], [SurveyorName], [Remarks], [CreatedBy], [CreatedDateTime], [UpdatedBy], [UpdatedDateTime], [CustomFields] AS [CustomFieldJson] FROM [McaPolicy] WHERE [IsDeleted] = 0 ORDER BY [UpdatedDateTime] DESC;
SELECT TOP 1 [PolicyNumber] FROM [McaPolicy] ORDER BY [CreatedDateTime] DESC;
